english.title: Use / damage a nuclear facility for purposes of terrorism - Terrorism Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the course of or in connection with the commission of an act of terrorism or for the purposes of terrorism

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[damaged]_

a nuclear facility in a manner which

(C)_[caused a release of radioactive material]_
(D)_[created or increased a risk that radioactive material would be released]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(2) and (3) of the Terrorism Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used/damaged a nuclear facility in a manner which
caused a release of radioactive material OR
created/increased a risk that radioactive material would be released
in the course of/in connection with the commission of an act of terrorism/for the purposes of terrorism

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Also consider the following offence wordings: Make radioactive device with intent to use in commission/preparation of terrorism (H8460); Possess radioactive device/material with intent to use in commission/preparation of terrorism (H8465); Use radioactive device/material for purposes of terrorism (H8461); Make demand relating to radioactive device/material/nuclear facility (H8462); Make threat to use radioactive material/device/nuclear facility (H8464).
(ii) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17.
(iii) For the liability of company directors etc. see section 18.
(iv) Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, section 19.
(v) See also Home Office Circular 8/2006, including explanations about this section.

other.powersofarrest:
For terrorist offences primarily consider: Arrest without warrant - terrorism
Also applicable: Arrest without warrant
other.penalty:
Imprisonment for life.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None This offence is also specified as a serious terrorism offence (Part 1 of Schedule 17A to the Sentencing Act 2020) and subject to serious terrorism sentences of imprisonment or extended sentences; see note (v) in section 306 for details.
